definitions.explanation: A suffix attached to a Sino-Japanese noun to mean "after that event": {退職後|たいしょくご} (after retirement), {卒業後|そつぎょうご} (after graduation). Written-style and very productive.

examples.japanese: {卒業後|そつぎょうご}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{就職|しゅうしょく}→就職：03209_shuushoku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I got a job after graduating.

examples.japanese: {手術後|しゅじゅつご}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{安静|あんせい}→安静：12267_ansei⟧にして⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please rest quietly after the operation.

examples.japanese: {退職後|たいしょくご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦どう→どう：00543_dou⟧⟦{過|す}ごす→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧のうち⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{考|かんが}えて→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧おいた⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧。
examples.english: It is better to start thinking now about how to spend life after retirement.

notes:
The on'yomi of ⟦{後|うし}ろ→後ろ：00683_ushiro⟧・⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧, used only as a bound suffix. It attaches directly to a Sino-Japanese noun with no particle, and the result behaves as a time noun.

COMMON EXAMPLES:
- {卒業後|そつぎょうご}: after graduation
- {退職後|たいしょくご}: after retirement
- ⟦{食後|しょくご}→食後：09499_shokugo⟧: after a meal
- ⟦{戦後|せんご}→戦後：12853_sengo⟧: postwar
- {使用後|しようご}: after use

USAGE:
It cannot be attached to native Japanese nouns — say ⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧ rather than combining {後|ご} with a wago word.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧: after — the free-standing word, used with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ after any noun
- ⟦{前|ぜん}→前〜：03957_zen⟧: pre-, before — the matching suffix, as in ⟦{食前|しょくぜん}→食前：20726_shokuzen⟧ (before a meal)
